decisions.title: How Elasticsearch turns on and off

options.name: A. Railway sleep
options.label: Railway sleep: Elasticsearch sleeps when unused and wakes when the controller calls it

options.name: B. Railway token
options.label: Railway token: the ingester deploys and removes Elasticsearch through Railway's API

options.name: C. Your word
options.label: Your word: the controller asks; you type a sentence to turn it on or off
